verdict.rationale: The evidence describes the MI325X as a CDNA3 datacenter accelerator: an OAM module in 8-GPU server configurations, aimed at ROCm AI/HPC workloads, Kubernetes deployment and cluster validation. Gaming upscaling and frame generation (DLSS/FSR) with broad game support is a category error for this kind of compute-only accelerator, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability.
